title: 6 Town Houses
subtitle: Dashboard
empty: Select a project to see details

welcome.title: Welcome to the Dashboard
welcome.description: This is your central view. From here you manage all projects, clients, and financial metrics. I will guide you through the main sections.

sidebar.title: Navigation Menu
sidebar.description: Access all CRM modules: Clients, Projects, Sales, Campaigns, Automations, and more.

language.title: Language Switch
language.description: Switch between Spanish and English for the entire CRM interface. This setting is saved in your session.

search.title: Global Search
search.description: Search for clients, projects, leads, and more from anywhere in the system. Shortcut: ⌘K or Ctrl+K.

notificationCreator.title: Create Notification
notificationCreator.description: Send personalized notifications to specific users or groups. Only available to administrators.

notificationBell.title: Notification Center
notificationBell.description: Review system alerts, overdue payments, upcoming activities, and messages. The red badge indicates unread notifications.

clock.title: System Time
clock.description: Shows the current real-time clock. Useful for coordinating activities and appointments with clients.

quickActions.title: Quick Actions
quickActions.description: The two most used buttons in the CRM: create a new real estate project or register a new client/resident.

createProject.title: Create Project
createProject.description: Open the wizard to register a new project with all its information, multimedia, and variable configuration.

addClient.title: Add Client
addClient.description: Register a new resident. They will receive an SMS invitation with instructions to set up their access.

statsStrip.title: Global Indicators
statsStrip.description: Consolidated view of your entire portfolio: total projects, clients, amount collected, and pending.

projectList.title: Project List
projectList.description: All your projects with their client counter. Click on any to see detailed metrics.

projectCard.title: Project Card
projectCard.description: Shows the project name and how many clients it has registered. When selected, details load on the right.

projectDetail.title: Project Detail
projectDetail.description: Here you see specific metrics for the selected project: clients, amount collected, pending, and current status.

clients.title: Project Clients
clients.description: Number of owners registered in this specific project.

collected.title: Amount Collected
collected.description: Total money effectively collected from this project. A key cash flow indicator.

pending.title: Pending Amount
pending.description: Total to be collected. A high number may indicate the need to activate collection campaigns.

phase.title: Phase and Status
phase.description: Indicates what construction phase the project is in and whether it is active or inactive.

openProject.title: Open Project Portal
openProject.description: Opens the project's public portal in a new tab, where residents can view their properties, documents, and pay their dues.

finish.title: Ready!
finish.description: You now know the Dashboard. Each module has its own guided tour. Explore the CRM with confidence!
